in_sanskrit.name: Boobalan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Boobalan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Boobalan means 'God's Grace'. This name is derived from the Tamil language and is rooted in Hinduism. It is a traditional name that carries the themes of strength and protection.
